title: Running local LLMs inside n8n workflow for free and with full data privacy
description:
Running local LLMs inside n8n workflow for free and with full data privacy.

I’m using LM Studio to run DeepSeek, Qwen3, and GPT-OSS locally, no terminal, no code, no API bills. Enable dev mode, copy the local endpoint, plug it into n8n, and your workflows run on your own machine.

Better security. Zero token costs. Same automation power.

Comment “W” and I’ll share the full video guide setup.
